source_description: Executed source from the archived n=9 G123 comparison run started 2026-11-14; identical to the model source in the 2026-11-03 comparison package after newline normalization.
configuration_scope: The entire n=7,8,9 input file is preserved from one archived n=9 G123 run. Complete result archives for all 48 combinations have not been supplied.
changes: Replace fixed n and group flags by --n/--groups selections matching every original manifest entry.
Keep input files beside the one self-contained source rather than one directory above separate instance files.
Put CLI setup and execution under a __main__ guard, retaining module-scope globals for the procedural functions.
Defer Gurobi import until after argument/input validation so import and --help do not require the solver.
Reject non-ASCII checkout paths before solver startup to avoid Windows Gurobi file-output failures.

group_definitions.1: Objective bounds, coordinate/product ordering and reflection restriction.
group_definitions.2: Instance-specific boundary restrictions and corresponding product equalities.
group_definitions.3: Fixed strip-derived y-coordinate bounds; no dynamic callback.
group_definitions.4: Horizontal/vertical strips and square-grid occupancy with exactly-one assignments.
